WORK_SUMMARY.title: Work summary
WORK_SUMMARY.help: Uses your existing department access. Performance uses the selected period; open and overdue counts describe the current state.
WORK_SUMMARY.placeholder: Summarize our department performance and open work

SIMILAR_CASES.title: Similar fault cases
SIMILAR_CASES.help: Enter the system or equipment and symptoms. Searches completed department work and its recorded details.
SIMILAR_CASES.example: Find completed cases similar to a printer printing error
SIMILAR_CASES.placeholder: For example: Our office printer does not print submitted jobs

SYMPTOM_ANALYSIS.title: Symptom analysis
SYMPTOM_ANALYSIS.help: Describe the equipment, symptoms, onset, impact and actions already taken to review relevant evidence and missing information.
SYMPTOM_ANALYSIS.example: My work PC will not turn on. I checked the power cable; only my PC is affected since this morning.
SYMPTOM_ANALYSIS.placeholder: Describe the equipment, symptoms, onset, impact and actions already taken
